commit 7ff045d1d50b1f3cc555b1ccab98098ef6c34872 (gh-pages, 2024-05-08)
MIT, Copyright (c) 2013 Lea Verou

A fork of Lea Verou's contrast-ratio. The public site is now
siegemedia.com/contrast-ratio; this repo is the last public source.

color.js is the WCAG relative-luminance and contrast-ratio math, copied
verbatim. The split-screen checker (two colours, a circle, a verdict) is
the same idea.

GifOS inlines classic scripts and drops type=module. The original page
loads Google Analytics, GitHub buttons, Incrementable from another host,
and a Siege Media advert. This port keeps none of those: nothing is
fetched.

The last pair of colours is saved privately. Upstream is a public website
with no save.
